b1plus-lazim.title: Must/Should: Lazim
b1plus-lazim.explanation: لازم (laazim, "must/should/have to") is followed directly by a present-tense verb: لازم أروح البيت (laazim aruu7 el-bayt, "I must go home"). Unlike English "must," لازم itself never changes form — only the verb after it conjugates for the person.
b1plus-lazim.fact: لازم can also stand alone as a short, urgent reply — "لازم!" by itself means something like "You have to!" or "It's necessary!", used the way English might say "You must!" as a complete sentence.

items.ar: لازم تشرب قهوة زين اليوم لأن انت طفشان كثير
items.en: You have to drink good coffee today because you're very bored
items.translit: laazim tishrab gahwa zayn el-yoom li-ann inta tafshaan katheer

items.ar: لازم تدري هي مبسوطة اليوم لأن شافت أهلها زين
items.en: You need to know she's happy today because she saw her family, good
items.translit: laazim tadri hiya mabsoota el-yoom li-ann shaafat ahilha zayn

items.ar: لازم ندري احنا تعبانين اليوم لأن ما شفنا الأهل
items.en: We need to know we're tired today because we didn't see the family
items.translit: laazim nadri i7na ta3baaneen el-yoom li-ann ma shifna el-ahl

items.ar: لازم أروح البيت الحين لأن أبغى راحة كثير اليوم
items.en: I have to go home now because I really need rest today
items.translit: laazim aruu7 el-bayt el-heen li-ann abgha raa7a katheer el-yoom

items.ar: لازم تدري احنا تعبانين اليوم، لازم تروح الدكتور معنا
items.en: You need to know we're tired today, you should go to the doctor with us
items.translit: laazim tadri i7na ta3baaneen el-yoom, laazim truu7 ed-doktoor ma3ana

items.ar: لازم يشرب مويه بارده لأن تعبان ومريض كثير اليوم
items.en: He has to drink cold water because he's tired and very sick today
items.translit: laazim yishrab moya baarda li-ann ta3baan wa mareedh katheer el-yoom

items.ar: أبغى راحة اليوم كثير لأن مشغول الصباح كثير اليوم
items.en: I really need rest today because I've been very busy this morning
items.translit: abgha raa7a el-yoom katheer li-ann mashghool es-sabaa7 katheer el-yoom

items.ar: لازم أروح الدكتور اليوم لأن راسي وجع كثير اليوم
items.en: I have to go to the doctor today because my head hurts a lot today
items.translit: laazim aruu7 ed-doktoor el-yoom li-ann raasi waja3 katheer el-yoom

items.ar: لازم تدري أنا مبسوط اليوم لأن شفت أهلي زين
items.en: You need to know I'm happy today because I saw my family, good
items.translit: laazim tadri ana mabsoot el-yoom li-ann shift ahli zayn

items.ar: لازم يروح المستشفى بكرا لأن مريض كثير اليوم
items.en: He has to go to the hospital tomorrow because he's very sick today
items.translit: laazim yruu7 el-mustashfa bukra li-ann mareedh katheer el-yoom

items.ar: لازم نشرب مويه ونروح البيت لأن تعبانين كثير اليوم
items.en: We have to drink water and go home because we're very tired today
items.translit: laazim nishrab moya wa nruu7 el-bayt li-ann ta3baaneen katheer el-yoom

items.ar: صباح الخير، أشرب قهوة زين، وبعدين أروح الشغل
items.en: Good morning, I drink good coffee, and later I go to work
items.translit: sabaah el-khayr, ashrab gahwa zayn, wa ba3dayn aruu7 esh-shughul

items.ar: رحت الدكتور أمس، وشفت أهلي، وشربت شاي زين
items.en: I went to the doctor yesterday, and I saw my family, and drank good tea
items.translit: riHt ed-doktoor ams, wa shift ahli, wa shirabt shaay zayn

items.ar: لازم أدري وين الأهل الحين لأن ما شفتهم أمس
items.en: I need to know where the family is now because I didn't see them yesterday
items.translit: laazim adri wein el-ahl el-heen li-ann ma shifthum ams

items.ar: مساء الخير، أنا تعبان اليوم لأن رحت المستشفى مع أختي
items.en: Good evening, I'm tired today because I went to the hospital with my sister
items.translit: masaa el-khayr, ana ta3baan el-yoom li-ann riHt el-mustashfa ma3a ukhti

items.ar: لازم أروح المطعم اليوم مع أخوي لأن جوعان كثير
items.en: I have to go to the restaurant today with my brother because I'm very hungry
items.translit: laazim aruu7 el-mat3am el-yoom ma3a akhooy li-ann jaw3aan katheer

items.ar: شفت بيت زين أمس، وأبغى أروح هناك بكرا
items.en: I saw a nice house yesterday, and I want to go there tomorrow
items.translit: shift bayt zayn ams, wa abgha aruu7 hinaak bukra

items.ar: لازم تدري وين تروح بكرا لأن ابويه يبغى يدري
items.en: You need to know where you're going tomorrow because my dad wants to know
items.translit: laazim tadri wein truu7 bukra li-ann abooyah yabgha yadri

items.ar: والله زين، شربت قهوة، وشفت صديق، وتعبان الحين كثير
items.en: Honestly it's good, I drank coffee, and saw a friend, and I'm very tired now
items.translit: wallah zayn, shirabt gahwa, wa shift sadeeq, wa ta3baan el-heen katheer

items.ar: أنا مبسوط اليوم لأن عندي فلوس كثير وشفت بيت زين
items.en: I'm happy today because I have a lot of money and saw a nice house
items.translit: ana mabsoot el-yoom li-ann aandi fluus katheer wa shift bayt zayn

items.ar: هي زعلانة اليوم لأن ما عندها فلوس تروح المطعم
items.en: She's upset today because she doesn't have money to go to the restaurant
items.translit: hiya za3laana el-yoom li-ann ma aandaha fluus truu7 el-mat3am

items.ar: لازم أدري كم فلوس عندي اليوم، بكرا أروح المطعم
items.en: I need to know how much money I have today, tomorrow I'll go to the restaurant
items.translit: laazim adri kam fluus aandi el-yoom, bukra aruu7 el-mat3am

items.ar: احنا تعبانين اليوم لأن رحنا بيت أهلنا الجديد
items.en: We're tired today because we went to our family's new house
items.translit: i7na ta3baaneen el-yoom li-ann ru7na bayt ahalna el-jideed

items.ar: لازم أروح بيت صديقي اليوم لأن تعبان ويبغى يشرب قهوة
items.en: I have to go to my friend's house today because he's tired and wants to drink coffee
items.translit: laazim aruu7 bayt sadeeqi el-yoom li-ann ta3baan wa yabgha yishrab gahwa

items.ar: أختي مبسوطة اليوم لأن شافت أهلها بعد شغل كثير
items.en: My sister is happy today because she saw her family after a lot of work
items.translit: ukhti mabsoota el-yoom li-ann shaafat ahilha ba3ad shughul katheer

items.ar: أخوي زعلان اليوم لأن ما عنده فلوس يروح المطعم
items.en: My brother is upset today because he has no money to go to the restaurant
items.translit: akhooy za3laan el-yoom li-ann ma aandah fluus yruu7 el-mat3am

items.ar: لازم ندري وين أهلنا الحين لأن مستعجل كثير اليوم
items.en: We need to know where our family is now because it's very urgent today
items.translit: laazim nadri wein ahalna el-heen li-ann musta3jil katheer el-yoom

items.ar: لازم أروح الدكتور اليوم لأن تعبان ومريض كثير اليوم
items.en: I have to go to the doctor today because I'm very tired and sick today
items.translit: laazim aruu7 ed-doktoor el-yoom li-ann ta3baan wa mareedh katheer el-yoom

items.ar: أنا مبسوط اليوم لأن شربت قهوة زين مع أختي
items.en: I'm happy today because I drank good coffee with my sister
items.translit: ana mabsoot el-yoom li-ann shirabt gahwa zayn ma3a ukhti

items.ar: لازم تدري كم فلوس عندك اليوم، بكرا تروح المطعم
items.en: You need to know how much money you have today, tomorrow you go to the restaurant
items.translit: laazim tadri kam fluus aandak el-yoom, bukra truu7 el-mat3am

items.ar: احنا تعبانين اليوم لأن ما رحنا بيت أهلنا أمس
items.en: We're tired today because we didn't go to our family's house yesterday
items.translit: i7na ta3baaneen el-yoom li-ann ma ru7na bayt ahalna ams
